title: pfaffia rufa
intro: Pfaffia rufa, commonly known as suma, is a plant native to South America that has been used for centuries in traditional medicine. The health benefits of suma include its ability to act as an adaptogen, reducing stress and anxiety while also improving overall well-being. Suma has therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to protect the body from oxidative stress and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of suma include vitamins, minerals, and plant sterols, including beta-sitosterol, which may contribute to its therapeutic effects.
